# Forening af praktiserende speciallæger

**Forening af praktiserende speciallæger** is a Danish professional association ("fagforening") of practicing specialist physicians. It appears in the corpus as one of the organizations represented in the steering group ("styregruppe") of the ADHD-databasen, a Danish national health database that monitors the quality of assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under the age of 18 [^src1][^src2].

The ADHD-databasen steering group brings together senior physicians, specialist doctors, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and relatives' representatives from across Denmark, alongside professional societies, patient organizations, all five Danish regions, and the Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut [^src1][^src2]. Forening af praktiserende speciallæger is named as one of the participating bodies in this governance structure, reflecting the involvement of Denmark's practicing specialist physicians in overseeing how ADHD diagnosis and treatment quality is tracked nationally. The organization is documented in two consecutive annual reports on the database — covering the period from 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024 [^src1], and again in the following report covering 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025 [^src2] — indicating a continuing role on the steering group across at least two reporting cycles.

Beyond its listing as a steering group member, no further details, relationships, or claims about Forening af praktiserende speciallæger are present in the available material.
